map.申请费 900 × 15% = 135 元 + 印刷费 50（不减）= 185: Filing fee 900 × 15% = ¥135 plus the printing fee of ¥50, which is not reduced, gives ¥185; with the examination fee 2500 × 15% = ¥375 and the grant stamp fee ¥255, official fees total about ¥815.
map.申请费 500 × 15% = 75 + 印刷费 50 + 授权印花费 205，: Filing fee 500 × 15% = ¥75 plus the printing fee of ¥50 plus the grant stamp fee of ¥205 gives about ¥330 in reduced official fees, with no substantive examination fee.
map.费用减缴条件？: What are the conditions for a fee reduction?
map.个人上年度月均收入低于 5000 元、企业应纳税所得额低于 100 万元等可申请: An individual whose average monthly income in the previous year was below ¥5,000, or an enterprise with taxable income below ¥1,000,000, may apply; the reduction is 85% for individuals and 70% for entities on fees such as the filing fee.
map.年费每年一样吗？: Is the annuity the same every year?
map.不一样，年费随年度递增（如发明第 1–3 年 900、第 4–6 年 1200…: No, it rises by year, for example ¥900 for years 1-3 and ¥1,200 for years 4-6 of an invention. It falls due before the anniversary of the filing date, with a late fee added after that.
